**L1-a: REWORK** at `3700f53df1f0c9598e53f4a565134371b4d3a651`: one declaration fix. The code is right.

- **Declaration.** `bucketCardsIntoColumns` is exported from `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`, the package's `.` entry (`dist/index.d.ts`), and this diff gives it a new optional sixth parameter, `keepUncolumned`. The Clause-② test is whether the change widens the accept set or the public surface (execution-duties.md). A new optional argument on a published export does, the same way the `ToastHandler` `description` member did on #38076. So both the PR body and the changeset should read `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, naming the export, with `Metadata-protocol: none` kept. That declaration owes a `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review, which I will run in this thread on the fix head. `KanbanBoardCoreProps.keepUncolumned` is not public, because `KanbanBoardCore` is imported, not re-exported.
- **The code holds.** `keepUncolumned` is gated exactly as the lanes past the page are: `hostLaneRead && flatLanes && lanesFromData && laneTargetObject`, and an `Uncategorized` count above 0. A partial or refused read answers `hostLaneCounts` null and draws nothing. Text-field and declared-option boards are untouched, as the changeset says. `bucketCardsIntoColumns` pushes one trailing lane with the page's uncategorized cards whether kept or not, and the bucket tests pin that, plus the no-card lane and a not-kept control. The ablation (`keepUncolumned` forced false) reds only the new pin.
- Out of scope, and right to keep that way: the same defect class on text and declared-option boards (a new card), and the Uncategorized lane that won't open (#37517).
- Face otherwise clean (`l1-face.mjs`, 13 items). CI at this head: 39 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed. SQL push-down: not applicable.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `916e7a838bcfb4e94c06641639817b87a83783dc`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- Face: declaration only. No `packages/spec/src/**` file and no governed path. The PR body and the changeset now carry `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · `Metadata-protocol: none`, so this review is owed at `TIER_DEFAULT`. The fix head changes only the changeset's declaration line against the reviewed `3700f53d`; the code is byte-identical.
- The widening is what the declaration names. `bucketCardsIntoColumns`, exported from `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`'s `.` entry, gains an optional sixth parameter `keepUncolumned = false`. A caller that passes five arguments gets exactly the old behaviour: the trailing lane is pushed only when it holds a card, and the not-kept control pins that. Kept, it still pushes one trailing lane with the page's uncategorized cards, never two, which the bucket tests pin as well. `KanbanBoardCoreProps.keepUncolumned` is internal, because `KanbanBoardCore` is imported, not re-exported.
- The host gate matches the lanes past the page: `hostLaneRead && flatLanes && lanesFromData && laneTargetObject`, and an `Uncategorized` count above 0. A partial or refused read answers `hostLaneCounts` null and draws nothing, so the lane can never appear from a count the board did not read. Text-field and declared-option boards are untouched, as the changeset says, and their twin defect is #38120.
- Card #37516: an "Uncategorized" lane whose records all sit past the first page is now drawn last, with its whole count and the "Cards not loaded" line. The list-kanban rig pins it, and the ablation (`keepUncolumned` forced false) reds only the new pin.

### ② Semver level

patch for `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: one optional parameter with a default that keeps every existing call's result, so nothing is refused or narrowed. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds, because nothing an author writes changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The out-of-scope items are carried by cards: #38120 (text and declared-option lanes) and #37517 (the Uncategorized lane will not open).
- SQL push-down: the lane count comes from the existing grouped lane read, so no new id materialisation or in-app join is added.
- No must-fix, no should-fix.
